description: Implementation of the TransformFeedback11 class for Direct3D 11 renderer in ANGLE project, managing transform feedback buffers and state.

classes.name: TransformFeedback11
classes.description: Handles transform feedback operations for D3D11 renderer, including buffer binding, state management, and serial tracking.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Prepares transform feedback for drawing, resets offsets, and invalidates state.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends transform feedback, optionally flushes the device context.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses transform feedback and invalidates state.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes transform feedback and invalidates state.

methods.name: bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer at a specific index for transform feedback, marks state as dirty.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Applies pending state changes, resets buffer offsets to -1.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the transform feedback state is dirty.

methods.name: getNumSOBuffers
methods.description: Returns the number of stream output buffers.

methods.name: getSOBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves the current stream output buffers.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number for the transform feedback object.
